items.title: Peak Flow share video for new single ‘Never Coming Down’
items.summary: Doncaster, UK duo Peak Flow released the single and video for "Never Coming Down" on 30 October 2026, across streaming platforms and on Bandcamp.
items.fullText:
Doncaster, UK duo Peak Flow released the single and video for “Never Coming Down” on 30 October 2026, across streaming platforms and on Bandcamp. Written by the duo, James Rollings and Jools Rollings, the song addresses the emotional intensity of entering a new relationship, caught between euphoria and vulnerability.

Musically, “Never Coming Down” pairs the band’s hooks with distortion and heavy fuzz, aiming for a sound that is both euphoric and uneasy. The accompanying video was shot among headstones in a graveyard setting, matching the song’s push and pull between elation and unease.

“Never Coming Down” follows the remix of “Don’t Die in Your Sleep,” a song about the sudden death of a close friend that deals with grief, helplessness and guilt. Of their songwriting generally, the duo has said: “All our songs are about different emotions that occur in life and we try to write songs that are powerful and catchy.”

About Peak Flow

Peak Flow is a post-punk and goth duo from Doncaster, UK, formed in April 2023 by vocalist and lyricist Jools Rollings and instrumentalist James Rollings. The band has described its sound as sitting between synth, industrial and post-punk, citing the influence of 1980s synth bands, 1990s industrial acts and post-punk groups such as The Jesus and Mary Chain and Joy Division.

The duo’s early singles “Running To You” and its remix were followed by “Don’t Die in Your Sleep,” reissued as a remix in September 2025, and by “Repetition.” “Never Coming Down,” released 30 October 2026, is the band’s latest single and video.

items.title: The Mission share ‘Kindness Is A Weapon’, announce album ‘Songs for Kith and Kin’
items.summary: The Mission released the single "Kindness Is A Weapon" and announced the album "Songs for Kith and Kin", out 2 April 2027 via Cooking Vinyl.
items.fullText:
British gothic rock band The Mission released the single “Kindness Is A Weapon” alongside a lyric video, announcing the album “Songs for Kith and Kin”, due 2 April 2027 via Cooking Vinyl. The 15-track album is the band’s first since “Another Fall from Grace” in 2016, and will be available on CD, cassette and double vinyl, with preorders open through the band’s official store.

“Kindness Is A Weapon” had already appeared in the band’s live sets before a hiatus around Wayne Hussey‘s open-heart surgery, with Hussey continuing to revise its lyrics until the song was recorded in June 2026. The surgery and recovery also delayed the wider album, originally planned for 2025. Hussey described the song’s premise plainly: “You can use kindness as a weapon for good, and you have to let things go at some point.”

Hussey, guitarist Simon Hinkler and bassist Craig Adams are joined on the album by drummer Alex Baum, who joined the band in 2022 and co-wrote the track “Roll With the Punches”. Hussey produced “Songs for Kith and Kin”, with César Lamschtein recording at Faro House Studios in José Ignacio, Uruguay, and additional orchestral sessions in Montevideo; the arrangements add keyboards, sitar and tamboura around Hussey and Hinkler’s guitars.

Hussey has said the album moves from concerns about his health and the wider world toward family, friendship and home, a progression reflected in its title. “Kindness Is A Weapon” is available to stream now; “Songs for Kith and Kin” is available to preorder on CD, cassette and double vinyl, in two colored-vinyl pressings, through the band’s official store.

The Mission’s first album since ‘Another Fall from Grace’

“Songs for Kith and Kin” follows “Another Fall from Grace”, released in September 2016 and produced by Tim Palmer, which marked ten years in the band’s catalogue this past September. That album featured guest vocal contributions from Julianne Regan, Ville Valo of HIM, Gary Numan and Martin Gore of Depeche Mode. “Songs for Kith and Kin” is credited to the same core lineup of Hussey, Hinkler and Adams, with Baum now established as the band’s drummer.

About The Mission

The Mission is an English gothic rock band formed in Leeds in 1986 by Wayne Hussey and Craig Adams after the pair left The Sisters of Mercy. They recruited guitarist Simon Hinkler and drummer Mick Brown, performing first as the Sisterhood before settling on The Mission and signing to Mercury/Phonogram’s Chapter 22 imprint. The band’s debut album, “God’s Own Medicine”, followed in 1986, reaching the UK top ten, with the single “Wasteland” reaching number 11 on the UK singles chart in January 1987 and “Tower of Strength” reaching number 12 in February 1988.

The band’s second album, “Children” (1988), reached number two on the UK album chart. Further studio albums followed through the 1990s and 2000s, including “Carved in Sand” (1990), “Masque” (1992), “Neverland” (1995), “Blue” (1996), “Aura” (2001, released on Playground) and “God Is a Bullet” (2007). Hinkler left the band in 1990 and rejoined in 2011, the year a wider band reunion was announced; Adams has also had two periods away from the lineup, returning in 2011. “The Brightest Light” followed in 2013, and “Another Fall from Grace” in 2016, released through Eyes Wide Shut Recordings and reaching number 38 on the UK album chart.

Alex Baum joined as drummer in 2022. “Songs for Kith and Kin”, due 2 April 2027 via Cooking Vinyl, is the band’s first studio album in over a decade, introduced by the single “Kindness Is A Weapon”.

items.title: Kalte Steine release German-language darkwave single ‘Hexentanz’
items.summary: Leipzig darkwave project Kalte Steine released the German-language digital single "Hexentanz" on 29 October 2026, its eighth self-released track.
items.fullText:
Leipzig darkwave project Kalte Steine released “Hexentanz” on 29 October 2026 as a self-released digital single, a German-language track drawing on the witch folklore of Germany’s Harz Mountains. It is the project’s eighth single and its first German-language release since June 2026.

The song is set at the Hexentanzplatz, the Witches’ Dance Ground above the town of Thale, where regional legend holds that witches gather each year at the devil’s invitation before flying on to the Brocken peak, also known as the Blocksberg. The lyrics name the gathering’s head witch, Watelinde, and follow two visitors drawn into the circle around her fire until dawn finds the clearing empty. Kalte Steine has said the song comes from firsthand knowledge of the area’s lore: “I grew up in the foothills of the Harz Mountains. There are many old myths and legends surrounding the Harz.”

Musically, “Hexentanz” opens on piano and storm sounds before a drum machine, bass and a cold guitar figure establish the track’s momentum, with brief synth pulses and crow calls threaded through the arrangement.

Where ‘Hexentanz’ sits in the Kalte Steine catalogue

Kalte Steine’s first four singles, “Shattered”, “Dysthymia”, “Wüste aus Beton” and “Kinder der Nacht”, were sung in German and released on Bandcamp in June 2026. The project then moved to English for three further singles: “Crying Out” (29 June 2026), “Drowning” (20 August 2026) and “Love Is A Lie” (24 September 2026). “Hexentanz” returns to German for the project’s eighth release. All eight tracks are self-released, with no label and no album to date, sold directly through Bandcamp and on streaming platforms.

About Kalte Steine

Kalte Steine is a darkwave and post-punk project based in Leipzig, Germany, that has not published a lineup or disclosed how many people are involved in its recordings. Recording activity became public in June 2026 with four German-language singles built around drum machine, bass, a single-line guitar, synthesizer and vocals set back in delay and reverb: “Shattered”, “Dysthymia”, “Wüste aus Beton” and “Kinder der Nacht”, tagged by the project as alternative, darkwave, goth, gothic and post-punk.

“Crying Out”, released 29 June 2026, moved the project’s writing into English, a language it kept for “Drowning” (20 August 2026) and “Love Is A Lie” (24 September 2026). “Hexentanz”, out 29 October 2026, returns to German and to the rural folklore of the Harz region where its author grew up, extending the project’s recurring themes of isolation and unease into older, shared stories of dread.

items.title: Delerium and Magic Wands release second ‘Exaudire’ single, ‘Dream Palace’
items.summary: Delerium released "Dream Palace" with Magic Wands on 30 October 2026 via Metropolis Records, the second single from the album "Exaudire", out 22 January 2027.
items.fullText:
Canadian electronic duo Delerium released “Dream Palace” on 30 October 2026 via Metropolis Records, a collaboration with US dream-pop duo Magic Wands and the second single from the album “Exaudire”, due 22 January 2027. A music video for the track, directed by Shahrnaz Nancy Southwick and Magic Wands, premiered alongside the single.

“Dream Palace” follows “Into the Light”, the first single from “Exaudire”, released in September 2026 with Diamanda Galás. Magic Wands, also signed to Metropolis Records, contribute guitar and vocals to “Dream Palace”, with Dexy Valentine of the duo writing the lyrics.

Valentine described how the collaboration came together, then how the video turned the song into a brief escape into another world: “The music Delerium sent us put us in a trance and we listened to it repeatedly to see how we could complement it. We came up with some guitar and a vocal melody, while lyrically I went with the dreamy feeling the song was giving me. The words were inspired by the music and also the end scene of ‘Contact’, a ’90s movie based on a Carl Sagan novel.” On the accompanying video, centered on a girl opening a wooden box, she added: “The imagery for it […] is about a girl opening a wooden box. As she looks into it she finds herself in a parallel universe.”

“Exaudire” will be Delerium’s 16th studio album and its 12-track lineup pairs Bill Leeb and Rhys Fulber with five guest vocalists in addition to Magic Wands: Mimi Page, Diamanda Galás, Inna Walters, Phildel and Jaël.

About Delerium

Delerium is a Canadian electronic music duo formed in 1987 by Bill Leeb and Rhys Fulber, who had just left Front Line Assembly, the electro-industrial group they continued to lead in parallel. Delerium began as an outlet for Leeb and Fulber’s dark ambient instrumental compositions, distinct from Front Line Assembly’s harder electro-industrial sound.

By the mid-1990s, the project had shifted toward largely downtempo songs built around guest female vocalists, a format that produced the duo’s best-known work: “Silence”, featuring co-writer Sarah McLachlan, from the 1999 album “Karma”, whose Tiësto remix became a worldwide dance-chart hit in 2000. Delerium signed to Metropolis Records, the label that already carried Front Line Assembly, for the albums “Mythologie” (2016) and “Signs” (2023). Delerium songs have appeared in the films “Brokedown Palace” and “Lara Croft: Tomb Raider”, and “Silence” was more recently heard in the BBC drama “Industry”.

“Exaudire”, Latin for listening, hearing and being heard, is Delerium’s 16th album, arriving on CD and limited oxblood-colored double vinyl. “Dream Palace” is the duo’s second new collaboration with Magic Wands after the album’s title track credits, following the dream-pop trio’s own releases on Metropolis Records, including “Switch” (2023) and “Cascades” (2025).

items.title: Green Tea Bitches releases Halloween single ‘Ghosts’
items.summary: Chinese-Danish dance-punk duo Green Tea Bitches releases the Halloween single "Ghosts" on October 30, 2026, from Copenhagen.
items.fullText:
Chinese-Danish dance-punk duo Green Tea Bitches releases the Halloween single “Ghosts” on October 30, 2026. The Copenhagen-based duo describes the track as pushing its dance-punk sound into “grimier post-punk territory,” built on a punchy electronic beat, fuzzed-out guitars and a theremin line.

“Ghosts” follows a narrator who boasts of fighting a polar bear and crossing the sea in a soda can before admitting, in the song’s chant-like hook, “I’m scared of ghosts.” The duo’s guiding philosophy, stated in its own press materials, is “bad taste means freedom.”

Green Tea Bitches formed in Copenhagen in summer 2025 and played more than 40 shows in its first year, including appearances at SPOT, Live At Heart and SHARPE. The band has released three singles in 2026 and is scheduled to perform at ESNS (Eurosonic) in January 2027. “The band (Green Tea Bitches) buzz through their set with endless energy and leave the hot, jumping room somewhat stunned,” according to CLASH.

About Green Tea Bitches

Green Tea Bitches is a Chinese-Danish dance-punk duo based in Copenhagen, formed in summer 2025. The band blends post-punk and electro-punk elements with a self-described “bad taste” aesthetic, and played more than 40 shows in its first year, including SPOT, Live At Heart and SHARPE. Green Tea Bitches released three singles through 2026 before “Ghosts,” out October 30, 2026, and is booked to perform at ESNS (Eurosonic) in January 2027.

items.title: Hallows – Dream (Digital/CD/Vinyl Album – Artoffact Records)
items.summary: Dom Rolando and Vaneesha Dusoruth, an American duo performing under the name Hallows, have now...
items.fullText:
Dom Rolando and Vaneesha Dusoruth, an American duo performing under the name Hallows, have now reached their third album. Following their debut on Cold Transmission Music in 2022 and a follow-up on Young And Cold Records in 2023, they have now joined forces with Artoffact Records for this ten-track opus. The album revolves around themes of human connection and loss.

Musically, the record is steeped in a vintage atmosphere, built around analog synthesizer sounds. The duo collaborated with an experienced producer who is well versed in analog equipment. What stands out is the almost blissful quality of the synths, complemented by 80s-style effects woven throughout the tracks. The synthesizers sound warm and inviting, fitting perfectly within the duo’s Electro-Pop approach. There is a well-crafted balance between calmer, almost sweet tracks and more dynamic compositions, driven largely by their rhythmic structures. Hallows have struck an excellent balance between classic 80s influences and a contemporary sensibility. The prominent female vocals add a touch of sensuality to the production, occasionally joined by her male counterpart. The album concludes with two remixes: the first, a very strong track by Inhalt, and the second, a remix by Nuxx.

While some tracks could perhaps have benefited from a more pronounced climax, “Dream” remains a highly pleasant and enjoyable record. Hallows do not simply imitate the 1980s; instead, they draw on those influences to create something that feels distinctly modern. (Rating:7½).

Listen to “Despite Those Times”:

About Hallows

Hallows is an American dark wave and post-punk duo formed in 2018 in the Minneapolis/St. Paul area. The project later relocated to Seattle and is now based in Los Angeles. Hallows consists of Dom Rolando (vocals, guitar, synth, drum programming) and Vaneesha Dusoruth (vocals, synth, bass).

The duo released the EP “Subtle” on Phage Tapes in 2020 and contributed a track to the Spotlight compilation on Cold Transmission Music the same year. Hallows’ debut album, “All That Is True,” followed on Cold Transmission Music in 2021. The duo appeared on the label’s “Spotlight Vol. 2” compilation in 2022, then released a second album, “A Quieter Life,” on Young And Cold Records in 2023. The single “Regret” followed in 2025.

Hallows’ third album, “Dream,” was released on Artoffact Records in 2026. The ten-track album includes remixes of “Find A Way” and “Dream.”

items.title: Boys Noize and Brutalismus 3000 share ‘Nächstenliebe’ from ‘7LLVSION’
items.summary: Boys Noize releases "Nächstenliebe" featuring Brutalismus 3000, a DAF-indebted track from his upcoming album "7LLVSION," out November 6 via ONES and ZEROS.
items.fullText:
Boys Noize has released “Nächstenliebe” featuring Brutalismus 3000, a new single from his upcoming album “7LLVSION,” out November 6 via ONES and ZEROS. The track is built on a step-sequenced bassline in the tradition of EBM pioneers DAF, an act the German producer and his guests cite as a direct influence.

Brutalismus 3000 vocalist Victoria Vassiliki Daldas delivers Dadaist, German-language vocals across a sparse, half-time beat, with a baile funk-styled vocal cutting through the chorus. “7LLVSION” is Boys Noize’s first solo album in five years and follows the single “1+1+1,” made with vocalist ZEP. The album’s full tracklist also features TAICHU, Mayah Alkhateri, ABRA and Safety Trance.

Boys Noize, the project of German-Iraqi producer Alex Ridha, spent the past two years working alongside Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross: he toured with Nine Inch Nails on the “Peel It Back” world tour, co-produced much of the “TRON: Ares” soundtrack, including the Grammy-winning single “As Alive As You Need Me To Be,” and formed the collaborative project Nine Inch Noize with the pair, debuting with a headline Coachella set.

Tracklist: Boys Noize – ‘7LLVSION’

  1. Illusion
  2. 1+1+1 (feat. ZEP)
  3. Take Me Out
  4. Nächstenliebe (feat. Brutalismus 3000)
  5. HYYTUP
  6. Baile DF (with Adame DJ, feat. Thalia Abdon, MC Da França)
  7. Wake Me Up (with Locked Club)
  8. I Need Luv (with Safety Trance, feat. ABRA)
  9. Sh5b0mbe
  10. Shut It Down (feat. TAICHU and Taube)
  11. Ycore (feat. Mayah Alkhateri)
  12. Sireneh

About Boys Noize

Boys Noize is the solo project of Alex Ridha, a German-Iraqi producer, DJ and composer who has written and produced for A$AP Rocky, Bon Iver, Frank Ocean, Arca, Virgil Abloh and Lady Gaga, and remixed Daft Punk, Depeche Mode, Miley Cyrus, Tame Impala, The Chemical Brothers and A.G. Cook. He co-founded the duo Octave Minds with Chilly Gonzales and produces and performs with Skrillex as Dog Blood. Ridha runs the labels Boysnoize Records and the newer ONES and ZEROS, and scored films including “Who Am I” (2014) and Oliver Stone’s “Snowden” (2016).

In 2025 and 2026, Ridha performed alongside Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross throughout Nine Inch Nails’ “Peel It Back” tour and co-produced most of the “TRON: Ares” soundtrack. The collaboration was formalized as Nine Inch Noize, debuting with a headline Coachella set and a same-week studio album. “7LLVSION,” Ridha’s eighth solo album and first in five years, follows that run, with “Nächstenliebe” offering the clearest EBM reference point on the record ahead of its November 6 release.

About Brutalismus 3000

Brutalismus 3000 is the Berlin duo of producer Theo Zeitner and singer Victoria Vassiliki Daldas, who met in 2018 and formed the band in 2020. The pair built an online following during the COVID lockdown period before taking their sound to European club and festival stages, including EDC, Primavera Sound, Coachella, Ultra and Lollapalooza. Their 2023 debut album, “Ultrakunst (Live From Earth),” was followed by the sophomore record “Harmony,” which drew on dubstep, trap, punk, nu-metal and techno. “Nächstenliebe” marks Brutalismus 3000’s feature on Boys Noize’s “7LLVSION.”

items.title: Ironic Sweden release ‘Get It Right (Sophie Rae Remix)’
items.summary: Ironic Sweden have released a Sophie Rae remix of "Get It Right" via Town & Towers Records, pairing the original synthpop track with a club-leaning rework.
items.fullText:
Ironic Sweden have released a new version of ‘Get It Right’, reworked by UK producer and vocalist Sophie Rae, via Town & Towers Records. The synthpop and electropop duo’s “Get It Right (Sophie Rae Remix)” keeps the original’s electronic core while moving the track toward a club-oriented, deep-house-leaning arrangement.

Sophie Rae, credited as an independent producer and vocalist whose work combines electronic production with her own vocal performances, built the remix around new rhythms and layered vocal dynamics. Ironic Sweden described the result as a way to give the song “new life, new meaning and expression.”

“Get It Right (Sophie Rae Remix)” is available to stream on major digital platforms via Town & Towers Records.

Ironic Sweden’s recent single run

Side-Line has tracked Ironic Sweden’s run of singles through Town & Towers Records: the band offered a double single via the label in March 2024 and followed it with ‘Media Whore’ in March 2025. The Sophie Rae remix of “Get It Right” extends that chronology with the act’s first outside remix collaboration documented on Side-Line.

About Ironic Sweden

Ironic Sweden is a Swedish synthpop and electropop act released through Town & Towers Records, the Gentofte, Denmark-based label run by Stig Wintendorff. The band’s Side-Line history begins with a double-single release via the label in March 2024, followed by the single and video “Media Whore” in March 2025.

With “Get It Right (Sophie Rae Remix),” Ironic Sweden hand the song to an outside collaborator for the first time in its documented release history, pairing the group’s electronic songwriting with Sophie Rae’s production and vocal work for a club-focused reinterpretation of the original track.

items.title: WVM shares Halloween anime music video for ‘The Echoing’
items.summary: Los Angeles artist WVM has released a Halloween special anime music video for "The Echoing," mixed by Sean Beavan, pairing the goth single with new visuals.
items.fullText:
Los Angeles solo artist WVM has released a Halloween special anime music video for ‘The Echoing’, out now on YouTube and Instagram. The clip sets the goth-tinged electronic single inside a supernatural, anime-style story for Halloween, with direction by WVM.

“The Echoing” combines ’80s goth influences, electronic textures and blues-influenced guitar in a track WVM wrote and performed on all instruments and vocals. The song was mixed by Sean Beavan and WVM. Beavan has previously worked with Nine Inch Nails and Marilyn Manson, among other acts.

“The Echoing” is also available to stream on Spotify.

WVM’s back catalogue and side projects

WVM is the solo project of a Los Angeles songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and vocalist working across electronic music, alternative rock and cinematic sound. Side-Line covered WVM’s single “Sown” in January 2017, an earlier entry in a catalogue that has grown to include collaborations with Christopher Berg, Sean Beavan, Josh Freese and Chris Vrenna, with music placed in television, trailers and video games.

Outside the catalogue of singles, WVM built Ludwig’s Empire, a browser game centered on the song “Empire” and a mascot character named Ludwig. Players who complete the game receive a code for a free Bandcamp download of that track.

About WVM

WVM is based in Los Angeles and works alone in the studio as a songwriter, multi-instrumentalist and vocalist, writing and performing the material himself before bringing in outside collaborators for mixing and production. The project’s catalogue spans electronic music, alternative rock and cinematic scoring, and Side-Line first covered WVM’s output with the single “Sown” in January 2017.

Since then, WVM’s work has included collaborations with Christopher Berg, Sean Beavan, Josh Freese and Chris Vrenna, and placements in television, trailers and video games. WVM also created Ludwig’s Empire, a browser game tied to the song “Empire.” “The Echoing,” mixed by Beavan and WVM, carries the project’s ’80s goth and electronic influences into a new Halloween-themed music video released this week.

items.title: Paulina Fae releases ethereal wave EP ‘The Way That Only Night Can See’
items.summary: Paulina Fae has released "The Way That Only Night Can See," a four-song ethereal wave EP on Projekt Records, as a name-your-price Bandcamp download.
items.fullText:
Paulina Fae has released ‘The Way That Only Night Can See’, a four-song ethereal wave EP, through Projekt Records. The release arrived October 29 as a name-your-price Bandcamp download, with wider streaming availability following on October 30.

The EP blends atmospheric electronic textures with soft, layered vocals across four tracks. Opener “The Earth Listens” moves through fallen leaves, soil and the steady pulse of the ground beneath the listener’s feet. The remaining three songs, “Flame Lily,” the title track “The Way That Only Night Can See” and closer “Dreaming in Slow Motion,” move through roots, shadows and hidden, unseen places.

Tracklist:

  1. The Earth Listens
  2. Flame Lily
  3. The Way That Only Night Can See
  4. Dreaming in Slow Motion

“The Way That Only Night Can See” is available now as a name-your-price digital download on Bandcamp, with release to other streaming services on October 30.

About Paulina Fae

Paulina Fae makes ethereal wave and dream pop, blending electronic production with soft, atmospheric vocal arrangements. “The Way That Only Night Can See” is her release through Projekt Records, the Philadelphia-based label whose ambient, dark ambient and dream-pop catalog has included Stratosphere’s name-your-price Bandcamp album “Cyclus” and releases from VEiiLA and The Palace of Tears. The EP continues her focus on atmospheric, nature-rooted songwriting set against textured electronic backdrops.

items.title: Tomorrows Letters – Shadow Aspect
items.summary: Warm analogue synths, an ’80s vibe and Jungian shadows: discover how Tomorrows Letters are shaping dark wave and synth pop with “Shadow Aspect”.
items.fullText:
Analogue warmth meets the dark side of the soul

Right from the very first listen, the warm, ana­logue synth sound on ‘Shadow Aspect’ by Tomorrows Letters imme­di­ately appealed to me. The Belarusian artist delib­er­ately eschews digit­al ster­il­ity and, using vin­tage hard­ware, real drums and a hand-played bass, cre­ates an organ­ic depth that is rarely found these days. Carried by a mel­an­chol­ic found­a­tion in a meas­ured mid-tempo, a clas­sic 80s synth pop sound unfolds, to which breathy vocal parts lend a fit­tingly sombre dark wave touch.

Theme-wise, the song delves into the deep­er lay­ers of the Jungian psyche. In the lyr­ics, a stranger wanders through his own skin like a ghost in a mir­ror image, until the meta­phor of the shad­ow self becomes tan­gible. An atmo­spher­ic, hand­craf­ted state­ment that com­pletely draws me in.

items.title: State Alchemist – Ash & Soil
items.summary: State Alchemist’s “Ash & Soil” combines a fat bassline with classic synth pop charm.
items.fullText:
When ash meets earth

What imme­di­ately reminds me of the very finest Swedish synth pop on first listen actu­ally comes, sur­pris­ingly, from the USA. State Alchemist sur­prise me here with beau­ti­ful, rich and won­der­fully undu­lat­ing bass­lines, car­ried by an incred­ibly catchy melody. It reminds me fondly of the sound of the duo ‘Red Cell’. Coupled with har­mo­ni­ous, emotive vocals, the track cap­tures exactly what I love about clas­sic­ally influ­enced synth pop.

The band them­selves describe the song as a story of attrac­tion told through the ele­ments, in which fire, water, ash and earth come togeth­er. When lines such as ‘Ash and soil when you meet me in the eye’ meet this smoul­der­ing sound, built on a subtle groove, I feel pre­cisely that music­al fric­tion born of enthu­si­asm and frus­tra­tion. In any case, I’m abso­lutely delighted to wel­come anoth­er such out­stand­ing track with a genu­ine touch of clas­sic synth pop into my ears.

items.title: Normoria – Jezebel
items.summary: Serpentine, sombre and perfect for October. Normoria’s attempt to combine dark wave and future pop. Does it work?
items.fullText:
A dark seduction in the perfect Halloween guise

The month of October is prac­tic­ally cry­ing out for the per­fect soundtrack, and with ‘Jezebel’, Normoria from Sweden deliv­er just the right dose of dark music for the Halloween sea­son. What imme­di­ately strikes me as a pos­it­ive when listen­ing is that the met­al influ­ence which had crept into their sound in recent years has all but van­ished here, or at least receded so dis­creetly into the back­ground that I’m not shed­ding any tears over it, espe­cially as I nev­er really got much out of those for­ays any­way. Instead, the band quietly bridges the gap between clas­sic dark wave and driv­ing future pop. I’ll delib­er­ately leave it open as to wheth­er this sym­bi­os­is works per­fectly every single second, but I cel­eb­rate the end res­ult as a con­sist­ently strong track.

Lyrically, the band focuses on an ice-cold seductress who, like a cun­ning viper, drives lonely souls mad and drags her vic­tims from the heights of heav­en straight down to hell (with a wink, the lyr­ics are almost in the style of power met­al). My only reser­va­tion con­cerns Angel Moonshine’s vocals. I would have liked a touch more acous­tic under­pin­ning in the mas­ter­ing, even though I much prefer this nat­ur­al pres­ence to over-the-top gimmicks.

items.title: Vampire Valentine – Broken Sins
items.summary: With ‘Broken Sins’, Vampire Valentine deliver pure dark wave. Eerie organ sounds, a driving tempo and pure catharsis.
items.fullText:
Between organ crypt and confessions

With ‘Broken Sins’, Vampire Valentine have delivered a real banger that is abso­lutely at home on their latest EP, ‘Scarred And Sacred’. Here, the English band explores the dark­er sides of the human psyche, both music­ally and lyr­ic­ally. At the heart of the song is the story of a man bur­ied under the weight of his sins and past deeds, who pleads daily for for­give­ness for the sal­va­tion of his soul. It’s a lyr­ic­al theme that really gripped me from the very first line.

I’m par­tic­u­larly impressed by the instru­ment­al real­isa­tion of this inner drama. The track picks up the tempo at a pleas­antly brisk pace and imme­di­ately invites you to dance, without los­ing any of its depth. What makes this song so spe­cial to me are the eer­ie organ melod­ies, which sound as though they’ve sprung straight from a clas­sic hor­ror film. Alongside this, care­fully placed syn­thes­iser accents provide strik­ing and clearly aud­ible high­lights. Vampire Valentine demon­strate a keen sense of atmo­sphere here, cre­at­ing a beau­ti­ful, sombre, old-school dark wave sound.
